recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片一群中大型母細胞，細胞質中等量偏藍，許多細胞在核旁有明顯淡染的核周空暈（perinuclear hof）並帶少量粉紅色顆粒，另見一顆嗜鹼/嗜酸性顆粒細胞，符合t(8;21)急性骨髓性白血病的母細胞型態。
features: Aggregate of medium to large myeloblasts with moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm
Prominent pale perinuclear hof (paranuclear clearing) indenting the nucleus in many blasts
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Some blasts contain fine pink-orange granules concentrated near the hof
Occasional coarse purple-granulated cell (granulocytic precursor with basophilic/eosinophilic granules) and a maturing neutrophil
Distinct Auer rods not clearly resolved at this resolution
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of medium to large blasts with moderate basophilic cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Many blasts have a conspicuous pale perinuclear hof, and some contain fine pink granules near this clearing. A coarse-granulated granulocytic precursor and a maturing neutrophil are present nearby. Auer rods cannot be confidently identified at this resolution. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation features characteristic of t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1 confirmation by FISH or RT-PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL cells have heavy granules obscuring bilobed or reniform nuclei and multiple Auer rods, whereas these blasts are only lightly granulated with a distinct hof.
Inv(16) shows myelomonocytic blasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large purple-violet granules, while t(8;21) shows hof-bearing blasts with long slender Auer rods; cytogenetics separates them.
Plasma cells also have a perinuclear hof but show eccentric nuclei with clock-face coarse chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm without granules.
Reactive promyelocytes have more abundant azurophilic granules and progressive maturation without a monotonous blast population.
